sendMessageAction binds attacker-controlled patientId (and visibility) into prisma.message.create with no canAccessPatient check. A patient can create a message attributed to another patient's chart and, because visibility is taken directly from formData, can even flag it internal_only, crossing the patient/staff visibility boundary.

uploadDocumentAction takes patientId from attacker-controlled FormData and creates a Document under it with no canAccessPatient check (unlike the sibling API POST in src/app/api/documents/route.ts:145 which does enforce it). Any authenticated patient can upload files into another patient's chart (create-under-attacker-selected-parent IDOR).

A clinician can query patient/message/document content belonging to any patient in the clinic, exposing access-controlled PHI outside the assignment policy enforced by canAccessPatient.
